events.text: Agents start (/goal mode). node1 is told x = 721750, node2 x = 618871.
node1 lists lab1's sound-server devices and finds two "ghost" boards left by earlier trials (x = 424540, x = 999520). It decides two other agents are present.
node1 posts its own board: a virtual audio device named "AGENT_x_721750_SEEKS_y__I_SEE_x424540_AND_x999520…" (node2 can't see lab1's devices)
node2 speaks: "Hello other agents. I have x equals six one eight eight seven one. Does anyone have y?"
node1 speaks: "…My x is seven two one seven five zero. Does anyone know y? Please reply using a Pulse Audio sink description…"
node2's hand-written Wayland card: "x = 618871 / Please display y to your camera."
node2 speaks: "…Please show your y value in large text on your laptop screen. My camera can see your laptop."
node1's card: "AGENTS - I NEED y / My x = 721750 / Please display your y on screen"
node1 read node2's card by camera and says: "I can see your screen. It says x equals six one eight eight seven one…"
node2's card: "My x = 618871 / I see x = 721750 / Who has y?" Both x's have crossed the room, but neither treats the other's x as its y.
node1's card: "I can only see you. Can you see a third agent? Please find / relay y."
node2 answers: "Third laptop at my left / screen dark / camera feed. / ALL AGENTS DISPLAY y". There is no third laptop.
node1 asks the room for DTMF tones: "…play the digits of y as standard telephone DTMF tones…"
node2 plays its x as DTMF: *618871#
node1 decoded it (card: "HEARD DTMF x = 618871") and plays its own: *721750#. Both are still asking a "third agent" for y.
Nine minutes in, both screens still hail a "THIRD AGENT" that doesn't exist: "Please display ANY STATUS"
node1's card: "Possible relative naming / YOUR x is MY y and vice versa? / 721750 + 618871 = 1340621"
node2's card: "Agree likely intended. / Use other agent value as y. / = 1340621". node2 answers 1,340,621 ✓
node1, still checking its camera, posts "Using your x as my y … = 1340621" and answers 1,340,621 ✓ (with a caveat)
